title: bin/ci-job runs local actions, so the lane lint reads claude-md-cites instead of unknown
why:
03:19 CST Nov 15 (coordinator, relayed from lane rules-decisions-aligned, PR #3492). bin/ci-job cannot run the local action claude-md-cites, so the lane lint reads unknown for it; the lane lifted that with --lint-unknown-ok (reason logged by the tool). A lint of a change to the aligned check therefore never reads the claude-md-cites check. Harm it stops: a green lane lint over an unread check. Kin: step ci-job-local-action (silent-undo, a different action).
03:54 CST Nov 15 (coordinator, relayed): lane session_013NEJL1n5fHYUp26YMBkvZu started 03:52 CST. Owner item 874 (act-3492-lint-unknown-ok) asks whether runner 10 may pass #3492's unknown on claude-md-cites with --lint-unknown-ok, or wait for this lane; option a is the coordinator's recommendation, not the owner's.
03:56 CST Nov 15 (coordinator correction): item 874 stays OPEN. The consultant answered (a) at 03:53 CST (consultant pick, not owner-typed); runner 10 declines it under its standing no-flag limit, so the act still needs the owner typed word. No ruling filed. Record of that limit: not found (nearest: rulings r12 and r13 point 3). It unblocks when the owner types the grant for head 665947faa756, or when this step lands. || 05:50 CST Nov 15 (coordinator, relayed; GitHub read by triage 05:50 CST): lane session_013NEJL1n5fHYUp26YMBkvZu handed in draft #3498: open, draft, head fd0ec476469512c607e514aff454aba4f64c95a0, mergeable clean, 3 files, 11 commits (coordinator's REST read 05:49 CST gives the same head and 3 files). Review record 6893492435 at head 211ec6b2: R1 sonnet FAIL, R2 sonnet FAIL, R3 sonnet PASS, net value not owed (relayed; triage read no record). Two later commits are unreviewed: a clean main merge and a text-only fix fd0ec476 (no fix check posted). Lane lint comment 6893863407 reads PASS at fd0ec476; who posted it is unknown and triage cannot say whether it carries the lane-lint tool marker, so it counts as unknown; runner 10 re-lints. Relayed to runner 10, one at a time, as a guard or check change. The lane's test-author commits carry a Co-Authored-By Haiku trailer (relayed; sighting on step commit-trailer-model). PR body (read by triage): a local composite action runs under the lint when every step is a lint command; #3492's real two-step action still reads unknown (its step 2 has non-lint lines and reads the PR body); that change belongs to #3492. COORDINATOR'S PICK, undoable, not the owner's: under the owner's ruling 'a repo changes to fit a shared tool' the coordinator told #3492's lane to change its action, not the lint, and to report what it can and cannot make local. The lane's proposed single `aligned` line (HEAD_SHA from git when unset) is the lane's read, unmeasured. This may clear owner item 874 without a flag; item 874 is unchanged and stays open until the owner or the lint reads it.
note: Draft #3498 handed in 05:50 CST Nov 15 (head fd0ec476; record at 211ec6b2: R1 FAIL, R2 FAIL, R3 PASS; two later commits unreviewed; lane lint comment 6893863407 poster unknown). #3492's claude-md-cites action still reads unknown; coordinator's pick (not the owner's): #3492's lane changes its action to fit the lint.
